items.title: Updated guidance on international data transfers
items.excerpt: Controllers relying on the transfer risk assessment template published in 2022 must complete a reassessment before 31 October 2026.

items.title: Fee schedule change for hazardous substances permits
items.excerpt: Permit renewal fees increase from 1 October 2026. Applications submitted before that date are charged at the current rate.

items.title: Consultation outcome: sanctions reporting thresholds
items.excerpt: The government will legislate to amend reporting thresholds when parliamentary time allows.
items.note: 公告未載明生效日與影響範圍，無法自行判定等級

items.title: Reminder: identity verification for directors
items.excerpt: Directors appointed after the commencement date must verify their identity before filing.
